title: Compass Improvements
description: Adds some functionality to the compass and some other items.
body:
## ABOUT:
> **Compass Improvements** - adds some functionality to the compass and some other items.

## EXAMPLES:
#### > **Compass - shows your coords.**
> 
> ![Compass show you coords](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d44546fec9419c812a3aefa79dab727ce9314dfc.png)
> 
#### > **Recovery compass - shows you last 3 deaths positions.**
> 
> ![Recovery compass shows you last 3 deaths positions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/116dede10b661270575d071780ec97a011471055.png)
>  
#### > **Clock's - shows your real time, date, and city**
> 
> ![Clock's shows your real time, date, and city](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8992e2fbba796a54dcb2551ae83db1306b6b3a0d.png)

## SUPPORTED VERSIONS:
> NeoForge 1.21.8/1.21.9
